2610.06354.title: GraphDecide: Benchmarking System One Models on Graph Tasks
2610.06354.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for graph understanding and decision-making, while System One models such as Jev select directly from supplied options. However, the capabilities of System One models on graph-related tasks remain unclear. We introduce GraphDecide, a model-independent benchmark that combines structural task profiles, matched graph-text input contrasts and heuristic-proposal controls to diagnose graph decision performance. We evaluate Jev and related choice-based models alongside language-model baselines, covering fourteen model-interface configurations. Jev's results illustrate the benchmark's central distinctions: accurate adjacency recognition does not guarantee broader structural correctness, joint graph-text input does not consistently improve prediction, and feasible construction does not establish high solution quality. Its task contracts, candidate interfaces and scoring rules support comparison across native selectors and language-model adapters. Code and aggregate results are available at https://github.com/VictorYXL/JevGraphBench.
2610.06354.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型 (LLMs) 正在越來越多地被探索用於圖形理解和決策制定，而系統一模型如 Jev 則直接從提供的選項中選擇。<lb/>然而，系統一模型在與圖形相關的任務上的能力仍然不清楚。<lb/>我們介紹了 GraphDecide，這是一個與模型無關的基準，結合了結構性任務配置、匹配的圖形-文本輸入對比和啟發式提案控制，以診斷圖形決策性能。<lb/>我們評估了 Jev 和相關的基於選擇的模型，以及語言模型基準，涵蓋了十四種模型-介面配置。<lb/>Jev 的結果說明了基準的核心區別：準確的鄰接識別並不保證更廣泛的結構正確性，聯合的圖形-文本輸入並不總是能改善預測，而可行的構建並不建立高解決方案質量。<lb/>其任務合約、候選介面和評分規則支持在本地選擇器和語言模型適配器之間的比較。<lb/>代碼和匯總結果可在 https://github.com/VictorYXL/JevGraphBench 獲得。
